title: #4 Advertising
prompt: Advertisements make people purchase things they don’t need or cannot afford, but they also convey information to increase people's life quality. What is your opinion?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Advertisements can manipulate people into buying unnecessary or unaffordable items, such as expensive phones, leading to overspending.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Advertisements can manipulate people into buying unnecessary or unaffordable items, such as expensive phones, leading to overspending.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Conversely, advertisements can provide valuable information about new services or healthier products, helping people improve their lives.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Conversely, advertisements can provide valuable information about new services or healthier products, helping people improve their lives.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Advertisements provide useful information about products and services.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Advertisements provide useful information about products and services.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Advertisements can make people want things they do not need.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Advertisements can make people want things they do not need.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Advertisements often pressure people into buying items they cannot afford, leading to unnecessary spending and impulse buying.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Advertisements often pressure people into buying items they cannot afford, leading to unnecessary spending and impulse buying.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: However, advertisements can also provide useful information, such as explaining the benefits of healthy food, helping consumers make better life choices.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: However, advertisements can also provide useful information, such as explaining the benefits of healthy food, helping consumers make better life choices.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph argues that ads provide useful information, which helps people improve their lives.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first body paragraph argues that ads provide useful information, which helps people improve their lives.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second body paragraph argues that ads can encourage unnecessary spending, which is a negative effect.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second body paragraph argues that ads can encourage unnecessary spending, which is a negative effect.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?

faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
